question: Should Nextcloud Talk structured rich-object webhook messages be normalized to rendered text for agent and command input, rather than exposing their raw JSON envelope, as this PR proposes?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and has live evidence, but it changes the compatibility boundary of the channel’s agent-visible body representation; that permanent behavior contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept rendered-text boundary
options.body: Merge after a current-main refresh, treating the parsed display and command text as the supported agent-facing representation for structured Talk messages.

options.title: Preserve raw metadata separately
options.body: Ask for a narrowly designed supported metadata seam if maintainers need agents or plugins to consume rich-object details beyond rendered text.

recommendation.title: Accept rendered-text boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after a current-main refresh, treating the parsed display and command text as the supported agent-facing representation for structured Talk messages.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline routes the initial review to this contributor, and the remaining choice is a compatibility-contract decision.
